verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing one-time passwords and importing passwords, logins, credit cards and secure notes from browsers and apps via CSV or Credential Exchange. None of that evidence covers bulk import of TOTP/2FA tokens from authenticator apps. General password import is an adjacent capability and does not transfer to this story, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
